sentences.text: Silutitan is a genus of euhelopodid sauropod dinosaur, a group of long-necked herbivores, containing only one species, Silutitan sinensis.

A fossil site known as a Konservat-Lagerstätte, a deposit preserving soft tissues exceptionally well, was reported in the Hami region of Xinjiang, China, in 2006. The holotype specimen IVPP V27874 was established for the new sauropod taxon Silutitan in 2021.
This holotype consists of six cervical vertebrae that all retain their neural spines.
The genus name Silutitan refers to the Silk Road, and the species name sinensis refers to China.
The fossil locality of Silutitan also contained the titanosaur Hamititan and the pterosaur Hamipterus.
Silutitan belongs to the family Euhelopodidae. Phylogenetic analysis places Silutitan as the sister taxon to Euhelopus.
Silutitan lived during the Valanginian stage of the Early Cretaceous, between 137.05 and 132.6 million years ago.
